name: log-transcript-theme
description: A log look for the transcript: YOU, CLAUDE and TOOL labels on every row, tool calls folded to one line, and a › beside each label that opens the row's details in a docked pane.

enabled.title: Enabled
enabled.description: Draw the transcript in this style. Off leaves Claude Code's own drawing.

youColor.title: YOU colour
youColor.description: Colour of the YOU label on your prompts: a hex colour or a theme key.

claudeColor.title: CLAUDE colour
claudeColor.description: Colour of the CLAUDE label on Claude's replies.

questionColor.title: Question colour
questionColor.description: Colour of the CLAUDE ? label on a reply that asks you something.

toolColor.title: TOOL colour
toolColor.description: Colour of the TOOL label on tool calls.
